scripts.lint: pnpm verify:billing-protocol && node scripts/lint-markdown-structure.mjs && node scripts/lint-breakpoints.mjs && node scripts/lint-navigation-surfaces.mjs && node scripts/lint-layers.mjs && pnpm lint:migrations && turbo run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @unlikeotherai/billing-statement-protocol build && pnpm prisma:generate && turbo run typecheck --only --filter=!@nessie/cli --filter=!@unlikeotherai/billing-statement-protocol && pnpm --filter @nessie/cli typecheck:prepared
scripts.build: pnpm lint && pnpm prisma:generate && turbo run build --filter=!@nessie/cli && pnpm --filter @nessie/cli build:prepared
scripts.macos:build: pnpm macos:project && xcodebuild -project macos/Nessie.xcodeproj -scheme Nessie -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' build
